 Comic Con India to Host GTA 6 Launch-Day Gaming Gatherings in Delhi and Navi Mumbai
 By EVENTFAQS Bureau - November 18, 2026 
 Facebook Twitter Pinterest WhatsApp 
 Comic Con India, a subsidiary of NODWIN Gaming, will bring gaming enthusiasts together to celebrate the much-awaited launch of Grand Theft Auto 6 (GTA 6) through two special launch-day gatherings on November 19, 2026. The events will take place from 2 PM to 6 PM at Saket Social in Delhi and Vashi Social in Navi Mumbai.
 The gatherings will give fans an opportunity to experience GTA 6 without having to purchase the game or own a gaming console, making the highly anticipated release more accessible to gaming enthusiasts.
 The Delhi gathering will be hosted by variety gamer and streamer Ziya Mishra (@ziyadotexe), while gaming and anime influencer Abhishek Ranjan (@abhi_abhishek10) will host the Navi Mumbai edition. Both hosts will bring their respective communities together for an afternoon of gaming and interaction.
 The initiative aims to turn the game’s launch into a shared experience, allowing fans to play, connect with fellow gaming enthusiasts and celebrate one of the most anticipated releases in the global gaming industry.
 Comic Con India regularly brings together communities across comics, anime, gaming, cosplay and entertainment through its events and experiences. Extending this approach beyond its convention format, the GTA 6 gatherings will create an opportunity for fans to come together around a major gaming launch.
 The initiative comes ahead of Comic Con India’s upcoming events, with the maiden edition of Navi Mumbai Comic Con scheduled for November 28–29, 2026, followed by Delhi Comic Con on December 5–6, 2026.
